BrochureContent.Content:
Janet Carroll Estate Agents are delighted to present No 4 Hampton Crescent to the market, this truly distinctive, architecturally redesigned residence. This stunning property was expanded to approximately 183ms / 1,969 sq.ft and is superbly positioned within the prestigious St. Helen`s Wood development in Booterstown, South County Dublin.

Behind its modest exterior lies a deceptively spacious home offering remarkable scale, light, and design ingenuity. Cleverly remodelled and extended by an architect, it unfolds into a series of stylish, contemporary spaces that feel both expansive, warm and effortlessly inviting.
Situated within the historic grounds of St. Helen`s Estate (circa 1870), now home to the elegant Radisson Blu St. Helen`s Hotel, residents enjoy a unique blend of heritage, tranquillity, and convenience, including a charming sylvan walkway linking directly to the hotel grounds.

This is a turnkey home finished to a high standard throughout, where thoughtful design meets comfortable living. Energy efficiency is also to the fore, with a strong B3 BER rating ensuring both comfort and cost-effective running.

Ideally located just off Booterstown Avenue, the property is within a pleasant stroll of Blackrock Village and benefits from excellent transport links including the N11 Quality Bus Corridor, Dart Station and a litany of cycle routes on your doorstep. The area is renowned for its exceptional amenities, including top-tier schools such as Blackrock College and St. Andrew`s College, as well as proximity to University College Dublin, Blackrock Clinic, and a wide array of shops, cafés, and restaurants in Blackrock, Mount Merrion, and Stillorgan. 

Additionally, both Dundrum Town Centre and Stillorgan Shopping Centre are just a short drive away too.
This is a home that offers something genuinely unique as it combines architectural flair, comfort and privacy, all within an unbeatable location. Early viewing is highly recommended.

Special Features
•Prestigious and highly sought-after residential setting 
•Architecturally remodelled and extended home of approx. 183 ms /1,969 sq.ft 
•Deceptively spacious interior with striking contemporary design 
•Presented in turnkey condition throughout 
•Private, low-density development with professionally managed grounds 
•Beautifully landscaped, enclosed rear garden with reclaimed architectural stone tiling 
•Surrounded by mature greenery and woodland walks 
•Energy-efficient B3 rating for modern, cost-conscious living 
•Fully upgraded monitored alarm system
•Integrated, fully wired smoke and carbon monoxide alarm system
•Owner-occupied and meticulously maintained 
•Annual management fee approx. 725 (covering communal landscaping and grounds upkeep)

Accommodation:

A welcoming entrance sets the tone for what lies beyond a thoughtfully designed interior where space, light, and functionality are seamlessly combined.

Entrance Porch: c. 1.81m x 1.81m.

A practical and stylish introduction to the home, featuring tiled flooring. Fitted storage.

Entrance Hall: c. 3.51m x 1.34m.

Finished with warm beech flooring, the hallway offers understairs storage and a glimpse through frosted glass into the kitchen, hinting at the contemporary layout beyond.

Kitchen / Breakfast Area: c. 3.73m x 2.91m.

A bespoke, well-appointed kitchen fitted with an extensive range of cabinetry and premium appliances, including a Franke stainless steel sink, granite worktops, and polished stone splashbacks. Integrated appliances include a Neff gas hob, Falcon grill, Bosch double oven and microwave, along with Hotpoint fridge and freezer. A breakfast counter with service hatch connects effortlessly to the dining space, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining.

Living / Dining Room: c. 7.24m x 4.40m.

This beautifully proportioned room strikes the perfect balance between comfort and sophistication. A feature Faber gas fire creates a natural focal point, complemented by elegant wood panelling and bespoke shelving. The beech flooring continues here, while a cleverly designed seated dining area with built-in storage enhances functionality. Double doors open directly onto the rear garden, allowing for seamless indoor-outdoor living.

Family Room: c. 7.02m x 3.16m.

A versatile and light-filled space with tiled flooring and underfloor heating. Ideal as a second reception room, playroom, or home office. Patio doors open to the front, while a feature space saver staircase (currently closed off) hints at the home`s flexible design potential.

Utility Room: c. 2.54m x 1.22m.

Conveniently located off the family room, this space is fitted with additional storage, a stainless-steel sink, Bosch washing machine, Indesit dryer, and Worcester gas boiler. A door provides direct access to the rear garden.

Upstairs:

A striking floating staircase leads to the upper floors, enhancing the home`s architectural character.

First Floor:
Main Bedroom: c. 4.36m x 4.17m.

A calm and beautifully finished principal bedroom with an extensive range of built-in wardrobes and overhead storage. Beech flooring adds warmth, while a private balcony overlooks the front.

En Suite Bathroom: c. 2.35m x 1.68m.

Elegantly appointed and fully tiled, featuring a concealed bath with telephone shower, separate rain head shower, W.C, wash hand basin in matching suite. Heated towel rail, recessed lighting.

Bedroom 2: c. 6.05m x 3.22m.

A generous double bedroom with fitted wardrobes, beech flooring, and access to a front-facing balcony.

Jack & Jill En Suite: c. 2.81m x 1.64m.

Stylish and fully tiled, complete with a walk-in shower with rain head. W.C., wash hand basin in matching suite. Heated towel rail shared with Bedroom 3.
Bedroom 3: c. 4.36m x 2.81m.

A bright and well-proportioned room with built-in wardrobes, fitted shelving, and access to a rear-facing balcony overlooking the garden.

Second Floor:

Bedroom 4 / Self-Contained Suite: c. 7.29m x 5.44m.

A truly impressive and versatile top-floor suite with a large dormer window and 1 Velux window flooding the space with natural light. This expansive room incorporates a kitchenette with granite worktops, Franke sink, Baumatic gas hob, and fridge, making it ideal for guests, extended family, or independent living. There is generous under-eaves storage and elevated views stretching towards the coast and Poolbeg Chimneys.

En Suite Shower Room:

Fully tiled and well-appointed, featuring a rain head shower, W.C, wash hand basin in matching suite. Heated towel rail, and Velux window.

Outside

The rear garden is a private, walled oasis, beautifully landscaped with mature planting, architectural reclaimed stone tiling, and a timber deck perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining.

To the front, there is a small neatly presented area with shrubs and hedging which enhance the home`s kerb appeal. There is one designated carparking space.
Additional visitor parking is available.


MANAGEMENT COMPANY

St. Helen`s Wood Management Company oversees the development. The annual management fee of 725 includes year-round maintenance of the landscaped grounds and mature trees, ensuring the development is consistently presented to an exceptional standard. The managing agent for the development is Paramount Estates Limited.
